FADE IN:

EXT. CASTLE - DAY

The majestic castle of King Reginald III stands tall, its stone walls adorned with the royal crest. But something is amiss. The once-majestic halls are now filled with the eerie glow of old CRT TVs, their screens flickering with distorted images of 80s VHS tapes.

CUT TO:

INT. THRONE ROOM - DAY

King Reginald III, a stout man with a thick beard, sits upon his throne, surrounded by his advisors. But instead of the traditional regalia, he wears a pastel pink tracksuit, complete with neon green stripes.

REGINALD
(to his advisors)
I have a vision, my friends. A vision of a new era for our empire. An era of... (he consults a dusty old book)...Vaporwave.

ADVISOR 1
(skeptical)
Vaporwave, Your Majesty?

REGINALD
(nodding)
Yes. The aesthetics of the future. The nostalgia of the past. The... (he searches for the right words)...the "wet" of the digital age.

CUT TO:

EXT. CASTLE GROUNDS - DAY

The castle grounds are now a surreal landscape of distorted, VHS-style video projections. The sound of distant, warped synthesizers fills the air.

CUT TO:

INT. THRONE ROOM - DAY

Reginald's advisors are now dressed in their own versions of vaporwave-inspired attire. One advisor wears a bright orange jumpsuit, while another sports a pair of oversized, mirrored sunglasses.

ADVISOR 2
(adjusting his sunglasses)
Your Majesty, I think we're on the right track. The people will love this new direction.

REGINALD
(smiling)
I know they will. For I have decreed that our empire shall be reborn in the image of... (he consults his book again)...the "distant" future.

CUT TO:

EXT. CASTLE WALLS - DAY

The castle walls are now covered in a strange, glowing moss. The sound of distant, distorted voices can be heard, whispering phrases like "FLUORIDE" and "CLOUD9".

CUT TO:

INT. THRONE ROOM - DAY

Reginald's advisors are now gathered around a large, distorted VHS tape. They watch in awe as the tape plays a never-ending loop of grainy, VHS-style footage.

ADVISOR 3
(whispering)
This is it, Your Majesty. This is the future.

REGINALD
(smiling)
Yes. The future is... (he pauses, searching for the right words)...foggy.

FADE TO BLACK.
